_comment: REFERENCE CREATIVE — the contract between the creative engine and src/render/. The creative engine writes files exactly like this one. Rule: shots[0].role MUST be 'presenter' (visible human opener), and presenter dialogue MUST be Roman/Latin-script Hinglish. See src/render/types.ts.
title: The 18 planetary hours (presenter-led)
hook: Your day isn't one mood. It's 18.
cta: Free Kundli — link in bio. Your Life, Decoded Hour by Hour.

shots.prompt: Medium close-up of a warm, natural Indian woman in her late twenties, minimal makeup, soft window light from camera left, calm modern apartment blurred behind her, shallow depth of field, vertical 9:16 framing, speaking directly to camera
shots.dialogue: Aapka din ek mood nahi hai. Vedic astrology mein din ke aththarah planetary hours hote hain — horas.

shots.prompt: Slow cinematic push-in on a deep navy night sky, faint golden constellation lines drawing themselves across it, fine star field, quietly premium, no text, vertical 9:16
shots.vo: Each hora has its own texture. Some windows are clearer, some heavier.
We compute all eighteen with the Swiss Ephemeris and Lahiri ayanamsa.

shots.prompt: Overhead shot of hands turning a page in a plain notebook on a warm wooden desk, morning light, dust motes, muted navy and gold palette, no text, vertical 9:16
shots.vo: Plain English. No jargon. Just when to act, and when to wait.

shots.prompt: Same Indian woman, same apartment and lighting, medium close-up, vertical 9:16, warm relaxed smile, speaking directly to camera
shots.dialogue: Free kundli banaiye aur apna timing grid dekhiye. Link description mein.
